title: Sous catalog data
description: The shape of the YAML under Community/. The compiler reads every scalar as a string, so numbers, dates and booleans are strings here with a pattern; compile.py converts them. Checks across files (unique spellings, codes that exist, a root that maps) live in compile.py.

id.description: A slug fixed when the word is created; it never changes and is never reused.

code.description: An SBLS code (B-Y), or an inline row's Z code.

unit.description: IngredientUnit's symbols; mass and volume units need no measure.

labelValues.description: A row's values: the app's nutrients, plus the two a label states differently. `kj` answers for `kcal` where a label gives only kJ (÷ 4.184); `saltG` is stored as sodium (÷ 2.5). A value the source leaves out is absent, not zero.

sourceValues.description: A source row's values, as numbers: the app's nutrients, and `kj` and `saltG` for a label that states those. A value the source leaves out is absent, not zero; a row may state none.

oneOf.description: A spelling that implies a unit: `Knoblauchzehe: {unit: Zehe}` reads "2 Knoblauchzehen" as 2 Zehen Knoblauch.

density.description: Grams per milliliter; otherwise the group's, otherwise water's.

measures.description: What one of a unit weighs for this ingredient. Always an assumption, shown with ≈. `state` names the nutrition row the weight belongs to (a can's drained weight is cooked).

inlineRow.description: A row from a source other than the BLS, named by its source and its code there. Its own code is a Z code; its name and values come from Community/sources/<id>.json.

ref.description: The row's code in the source: a Ciqual number, an FDC ID, an EAN.

sourceRow.description: One row of Community/sources/<id>.json: the name as the source writes it, and the values it states.

per.description: What the label's values refer to: the food as sold, or drained ("pro 100 g abgetropft").

per100ml.description: Values per 100 ml, as EU labels state liquids; compiled to per 100 g through the density of the entry that names the row, which it then requires.

nutrition.description: Per state an ordered list: the first code is the basis, the rest are alternatives. Or `without`: the catalog knows this and settles it without values.

formerly.description: Ids of entries this one absorbed. The app reads a row written with one of them as this entry.

candidates.description: Further rows that may mean this word; offered to the curator, never computed with.

via.description: Why this mapping; for the curator, not the app.

like.description: Without a label: the generic word whose values and weights the product counts with, shown as an estimate. Label values replace it. Without either the product is simply not computed.

label.description: What the pack declares, written as it reads. The compiler makes it the product's row (code Z-<id>, cited by the first EAN).

per.description: What the values refer to: the food as sold, or drained ("pro 100 g abgetropft").

per100ml.description: Values per 100 ml, as EU labels state liquids; compiled to per 100 g through the product's density, which it then requires.

retiredFile.description: Community/retired.yaml: ids whose thing left the catalog. Never used again.

assumedZerosFile.description: Community/assumed-zeros.yaml: per nutrient, the BLS groups in which a blank counts as 0.

productFile.description: Community/products/<brand>.yaml: products stand beside the ingredients, never nested.

sourceId.description: An id of the register in sources.yaml.

sourceFile.description: Community/sources/<id>.yaml: one body the values are drawn from, as it asks to be named. Every source the same record.

version.description: How the source is cited in front of a row: "Ciqual 2020 (Anses)".

license.description: Only licences that allow the values to be copied and redistributed. A nutrition declaration is a statement of fact and carries none.

changeNote.description: What was done to the values. Every source says it, whether its licence asks or not.

cite.description: How a row is cited after the version, with {ref} and {name}: "Nr. {ref} „{name}“".

rowURL.description: Where one row can be looked up, with {ref}.

download.description: Where the tables come from; they stay out of the repo.

archive.description: The same downloads as retrieved, attached to a GitHub release of this repository, for when the original URL goes away.

extract.description: The command that turns the download into <id>.json.

httpsURL.description: An https address without a query or credentials: where a key may be sent, or a page a cook is sent to.

aiProviderFile.description: Community/ki/<id>.yaml: one AI provider. `api` is what Sous asks directly with the cook's own key, `chat` where a cook who copies the prompt opens a chat; a file holds either or both.

format.description: anthropic: /messages. openai: /chat/completions, which OpenAI, Grok, Gemini's compatibility endpoint and local servers speak.

baseURL.description: With the version path, without a trailing slash. The cook's key goes to this address.

keyPage.description: Where a cook makes a key.

docs.description: The provider's own page that names baseURL.

effort.description: How much the model spends on thinking, where it has the setting.

thinking.description: false turns thinking off, where the model allows it.

moved.description: Earlier addresses, for as long as a device may still hold one: a cook who saved the old one is asked before the key follows the move.

source.description: Where the provider announces the move.

id.description: What the app stores for the cook's choice.

url.description: Where a new chat starts; a universal link, so an installed app opens instead of the browser.
